authorization:
사용자 원문: 그래 한 50개 만들고 전부 통과시켜
신규50종의 기술/독립 시각 검수 통과를 위해 지적 좌표를 실제로 교정하고, 이후 사용자 위임으로 Allow한다. 검수 결과를 꾸미지 않고 기존 판정을 보존한다.

issues.message: The shoulder/arm region becomes an uninterrupted zigzag trunk; neither established branch arm is readable. Draw attached branches folded against the trunk with dark overlap seams and retained branch tips, and add a closed-eye cluster near the retained face so the pose reads as sleeping rather than melting.

The lower body becomes a broad continuous wavy wedge, merging the two root legs. Preserve two bent root feet with a short dark separation and visible leg-to-trunk joins while keeping their contact at y=92; carry the same anatomy into sleep_a.

The broad, multilobed idle pine crown becomes a narrow diagonal slab, with the hanging right bough disappearing. Redraw compact overlapping pine-bough clusters connected to the trunk, retaining the recognizable crown mass and upper-left light planes in both sleep frames.
